instruction.name: vfmaxa.s
instruction.description: Compute the maximum (maxNumMag) of single precision floating point elements in `a` and `b`, selecting the element with the larger absolute value.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500.
